description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend gist, and analyze important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. If you are sitting next to someone who might be chatting with you during class, move to another seat so you don't give in to temptation.
You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones and PDAs are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent

gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Learning Success Statement Please rest assured, I hope that all students can complete various learning tasks according to the teaching progress, participate in various learning activities in a regular and active manner, hand in homework on time, complete various learning tasks, and meet the learning objectives of this course. If you encounter learning difficulties during the school year, please make good use of my benefit time, or make another appointment with me to seek improvement solutions together. Classes invite students to form learning communities to review before exams, including tips from former students who have been successful in the course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: • 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。剽竊是對學術信任的嚴重破壞。在學習作業中，我們的言論和想法就是我們作業的價值；因此將他人的作品當作自己的作品繳交，是一種盜竊行為。當您使用別人的文字和想法時，無論是著名作家還是同學的作品，而不註明這些文章、詞語和想法的來源出處，您的行為就是在抄襲。原創性作品是我的底線，抄襲的作品將會收到“0”或“不及格”的分數。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.

courseBankC.core_eng: Communication Skills：To be equipped with the skills of effective verbal and non-verbal  interaction  and team work communication.

courseBankC.core_item: 價值判斷：能尊重多元價值；能進行價值的反思；能提出個人的價值判斷。
courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking：To be equipped with multiple perspectives and tolerance of differences to identify problems, engage in reflective and critical thinking to resolutions.
